description: This file contains React components that function as route guards requiring authentication and owner role verification within a React application. It utilizes hooks like useAuth and useLocation, and renders UI components such as EmptyState and navigation components like Navigate to enforce access control.

methods.name: RequireAuth({ children })
methods.description: A React component that enforces authentication on a route, displaying a loading state or redirecting to login as necessary.
